onboarding.intro:
Configure local options and review tools before continuing.

Enter starts setup. Esc exits without changing the project.
onboarding.summary.title: Setup summary
onboarding.language.title: Terminal language
onboarding.language.help: Brazilian Portuguese is recommended. You can change the output language later.
onboarding.language.label: Language: %s (←/→ to change)
onboarding.agents.title: Local agents and tools
onboarding.install.title: Install missing tools
onboarding.install.help: Use Space to select. Nothing is installed without explicit confirmation.
onboarding.install.confirm: Confirm this exact plan? Press y to accept or n to skip.
onboarding.trust.title: Trusted folder confirmation
onboarding.trust.help: Trust allows tool discovery and access to project files when requested. It does not approve commands or installations.
onboarding.trust.keep: Keep untrusted (default). Press y or n to choose.
onboarding.permissions.title: Permission profile (←/→ to change: %s)
onboarding.profile.restricted.help: Ask before writing, running commands, installing, or using the network.
onboarding.profile.balanced.help: Allow common actions; ask before risky or external actions.
onboarding.profile.autonomous.help: Allow common actions; sensitive operations still require approval.
onboarding.dashboard.help: ↑/↓ changes dashboard mode; Tab changes the edition.
